topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: The den my grandmother tended for years now holds more shadows. They linger, whispers where the walls meet, even as the two of us who now walk these paths try to carve out our own scents, our own warmth. I can feel the walls watching, the floorboards remembering. The air is thick with memories not fully understood, the weight of them pressing in. Every creak speaks of a time I did not know, a time that seems both alien and achingly close. The forest outside seems less threatening than the silence within these walls. I don't want to disturb the echoes, yet I cannot stay still.
